title: What is HisabDo?
content: HisabDo is an offline-first khata and ledger app for Android. It helps users track money given and received, customer balances, and expenses. PDF reports are available for supported records.

title: How do I categorize an expense?
content: The existing FAQ describes expense categorization as a combination of rule-based matching and a machine-learning model. It states that uncertain predictions are flagged for the user to confirm or correct. Confirm this workflow against the current application before publishing.
source_reference: Existing HisabDo FAQ; product confirmation required

title: How do I export my expenses?
content: HisabDo supports PDF reports for supported records. Official documentation describes reports for transactions, customer balances, and customer activity. The exact steps may depend on the screen and record being viewed. CSV export is not confirmed by the source.

title: What is profit?
content: Profit is the amount remaining after expenses are subtracted from revenue, according to the applicable accounting method.
source_reference: OpenStax, Principles of Financial Accounting, Section 2.1 — https://openstax.org/books/principles-financial-accounting/pages/2-1-describe-the-income-statement-statement-of-owners-equity-balance-sheet-and-statement-of-cash-flows-and-how-they-interrelate

title: How can I understand Udhar or customer balances?
content: HisabDo helps users track money given and received and customer balances. A receivable is money owed to the user; a payable is money the user owes. Exact screen steps for all Udhar actions have not been verified. Roman Urdu queries: Udhar ka record kaise dekhoon? Udhar ka hisaab kaise check karun? Kis customer ne kitne paise dene hain?
